conflicts.finding: IONIQ 5 and EV6 share several E-GMP diagnostic addresses, but their source payload inventories differ and no stable ECU fingerprint proves decoder equivalence across models or Genesis.
conflicts.resolution: Keep model-specific routes and decoders separate until exact ECU identity and payload behavior reproduce.

conflicts.finding: Across eleven public model corpora, route 7A0/7A8 DID C00B repeats, but at least three wheel-order/byte-spacing layouts occur. BMS 7E4/7EC DID 0101 also repeats across legacy EV and E-GMP models with different payload semantics.
conflicts.resolution: Keep model variants separate. Promote reusable ECU-family decodes only after an exact hardware/software fingerprint joins the fitted ECU and the payload reproduces on project vehicles.
